definition: Same 200-row collection and selected /items. Eight append/update/remove cycles on unrelated completed sessions, with one repeat after each cycle. Compare nine full reads against one full plus eight conditional reads. Shared initial read in the harness; independent workflow counts are nine each.
limitations: Synthetic warm repeated selection; no wall-clock gate or claim about all live workloads. Selected-source mutation, stripping and reappearance remain misses. Prior baseline remains immutable.
